Frequently asked questions

Can I use my own AI provider API keys?

Yes! Starter and above allow you to add your own keys for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, Mistral, and more. Your keys, your costs.

What counts as a "task"?

A task is one unit of work dispatched to an agent. It may involve multiple LLM calls internally, but it counts as one task for billing purposes.

What is compute?

Compute hours are for dedicated server instances where your agents run. Shared compute is included on all plans for lighter workloads.

Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?

Yes. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated on your next invoice.
